business_model: B2B chip design tooling (demo and waitlist; pricing not public)
product_category: EDA waveform debugging and capture tools

technical_complexity.rationale: Lossless capture of internal signals at large scale with a claimed 500x size reduction plus ML on waveform history needs specialist simulator and compression expertise.

defensibility.rationale: Hard compression and format work plus EDA integration are difficult to copy, but incumbents control waveform formats and simulators.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Both incumbents already ship AI debug features; no acquisition of the company found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Chip teams multiplied with the AI boom and waveform files from simulation are very large; incumbents' tools are slow to open per the founders' launch post.

identity.visual_style: minimal with arrow symbols in calls to action
identity.voice_and_tone: short tagline: make sense of silicon

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name and a memorable tagline, but no press or community evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Hardware Intelligence is an active Summer 2026 company that launched the Wave debugger in July 2026 and announced WaveZip for August. The founders have chip simulation and EDA experience. Incumbent EDA vendors and agentic chip startups are the main competition. No funding or outcome event is public.
